mapper.sql: WITH RECURSIVE visible_categories AS ( SELECT id FROM categories WHERE visible = 1 AND ((#{categoryId} IS NULL AND parent_id IS NULL) OR id = #{categoryId}) UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM categories child JOIN visible_categories parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.visible = 1 )

p.id, p.name, cover.media_id AS coverMediaId, b.id AS brandId, b.name AS brandName, s.id AS shopId, s.name AS shopName, COALESCE((SELECT MIN(sku.price) FROM skus sku FORCE INDEX (uk_skus_product_id_option_signature) WHERE sku.product_id = p.id AND sku.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sku.stock > 0 AND (#{minPrice} IS NULL OR sku.price >= #{minPrice}) AND (#{maxPrice} IS NULL OR sku.price <= #{maxPrice})), (SELECT MIN(sku.price) FROM skus sku FORCE INDEX (uk_skus_product_id_option_signature) WHERE sku.product_id = p.id AND sku.status = 'ACTIVE')) AS startingPrice, COALESCE(sales.sold_count, 0) AS soldCount, NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM skus sku FORCE INDEX (uk_skus_product_id_option_signature) WHERE sku.product_id = p.id AND sku.status = 'ACTIVE' AND sku.stock > 0) AS soldOut

LEFT JOIN product_brands pb ON pb.product_id = p.id LEFT JOIN product_images cover ON cover.product_id = p.id AND cover.is_cover = 1 LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = pb.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_sales_stats sales ON sales.product_id = p.id

WHERE p.status = 'ON_SALE' AND (#{brandId} IS NULL OR pb.brand_id = #{brandId}) AND (#{shopId} IS NULL OR p.shop_id = #{shopId}) AND (SELECT sku.id FROM skus sku FORCE INDEX (uk_skus_product_id_option_signature) WHERE sku.product_id = p.id AND sku.status = 'ACTIVE' AND ((#{minPrice} IS NULL AND #{maxPrice} IS NULL) OR (sku.stock > 0 AND (#{minPrice} IS NULL OR sku.price >= #{minPrice}) AND (#{maxPrice} IS NULL OR sku.price <= #{maxPrice}))) LIMIT 1) IS NOT NULL

FROM products p FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) STRAIGHT_JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.qualification_revoked = 0 AND (s.qualification_valid_until IS NULL OR s.qualification_valid_until >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) STRAIGHT_JOIN visible_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id

FROM products p JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.qualification_revoked = 0 AND (s.qualification_valid_until IS NULL OR s.qualification_valid_until >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) JOIN visible_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id

FROM product_brands pb FORCE INDEX (fk_product_brands_brand_id) STRAIGHT_JOIN products p ON p.id = pb.product_id STRAIGHT_JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.qualification_revoked = 0 AND (s.qualification_valid_until IS NULL OR s.qualification_valid_until >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) STRAIGHT_JOIN visible_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id LEFT JOIN product_images cover ON cover.product_id = p.id AND cover.is_cover = 1 LEFT JOIN brands b ON b.id = pb.brand_id LEFT JOIN product_sales_stats sales ON sales.product_id = p.id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM products p FORCE INDEX (idx_products_shop_status_id) STRAIGHT_JOIN shops s ON s.id = p.shop_id AND s.enabled = 1 AND s.qualification_revoked = 0 AND (s.qualification_valid_until IS NULL OR s.qualification_valid_until >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) STRAIGHT_JOIN visible_categories c ON c.id = p.category_id
AND p.shop_id = #{shopId} AND (#{afterId} IS NULL OR p.id < #{afterId}) ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

choose.otherwise: MATCH (${column}) AGAINST (#{filter.keyword} IN NATURAL LANGUAGE MODE)

mapper.select: SELECT candidate.id, candidate.name FROM shops candidate WHERE candidate.enabled = 1 AND candidate.qualification_revoked = 0 AND (candidate.qualification_valid_until IS NULL OR candidate.qualification_valid_until >= DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP() + INTERVAL 8 HOUR)) AND ORDER BY (candidate.name = #{filter.keyword}) DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT candidate.id, candidate.name FROM brands candidate WHERE candidate.enabled = 1 AND ORDER BY (candidate.name = #{filter.keyword}) DESC, candidate.id DESC LIMIT 5
